allspice dram: Pinch of ground allspice + 0.25 oz dark rum
st. elizabeth allspice dram: Pinch of ground allspice + 0.25 oz dark rum
falernum: 0.5 oz simple syrup + pinch clove + dash lime juice + dash almond extract
velvet falernum: 0.5 oz simple syrup + pinch clove + dash lime juice + dash almond extract
orgeat: Equal parts almond milk + simple syrup, or 0.5 oz simple syrup + 2 drops almond extract
honey syrup: 1:1 honey and warm water, stirred until dissolved
honey water: 1:1 honey and warm water, stirred until dissolved
simple syrup: Equal parts sugar and hot water, stirred until dissolved
demerara syrup: Simple syrup made with demerara or raw sugar instead of white
agave syrup: Simple syrup or honey syrup work well; agave nectar diluted 1:1 with water
grenadine: Pomegranate juice reduced with equal sugar, or raspberry syrup
aperol: Campari (more bitter) or any orange-forward amaro
cocchi americano: Lillet Blanc or dry vermouth with a dash of orange bitters
cocchi vermouth di torino: Carpano Antica or Dolin Rouge sweet vermouth
carpano antica: Cocchi Vermouth di Torino or Dolin Rouge
dolin rouge: Any quality sweet vermouth — Carpano Antica, Cocchi di Torino
dry vermouth: A splash of dry white wine with a drop of olive brine
sweet vermouth: Any quality sweet vermouth — Carpano Antica, Dolin Rouge, Cocchi di Torino
st. germain: 0.5 oz simple syrup + a few drops of elderflower cordial, or elderflower tonic
elderflower liqueur: St. Germain, or 0.5 oz simple syrup + elderflower cordial
creme de cassis: Blackcurrant jam thinned with a splash of water and sugar, or Chambord
chambord: Creme de cassis or any black raspberry liqueur
maraschino liqueur: 0.25 oz simple syrup + a drop of almond extract (approximate)
luxardo maraschino: 0.25 oz simple syrup + a drop of almond extract (approximate)
cointreau: Triple sec, Grand Marnier, or any orange liqueur
blue curacao: Triple sec or Cointreau (color will differ)
creme de menthe: A drop of peppermint extract in simple syrup
creme de violette: Skip it or add a small amount of violet liqueur if available
benedictine: A mix of honey syrup + a drop of herbal bitters (approximate)
chartreuse: Cannot truly substitute; skip or use a herbal liqueur like Bénédictine
green chartreuse: Cannot truly substitute; use yellow Chartreuse for milder flavor
amaro nonino: Aperol + a dash of orange bitters, or any lighter amaro
fernet branca: Any amaro with extra bitters; no perfect sub — use sparingly
kahlua: Strong cold brew coffee + simple syrup, or any coffee liqueur
coffee liqueur: Strong cold brew coffee + simple syrup
baileys: Heavy cream + a splash of Irish whiskey + a teaspoon of chocolate syrup
frangelico: Hazelnut syrup or a few drops of hazelnut extract in simple syrup
amaretto: 0.5 oz simple syrup + 2 drops almond extract
disaronno: Amaretto or 0.5 oz simple syrup + almond extract
peach schnapps: Peach nectar + a splash of vodka
creme de peche: Peach nectar + a splash of vodka or simple syrup
raspberry liqueur: Chambord or muddled fresh raspberries + simple syrup
passion fruit syrup: Passion fruit juice reduced with equal parts sugar
passionfruit syrup: Passion fruit juice reduced with equal parts sugar
mango syrup: Mango nectar reduced with equal parts sugar
ginger syrup: Muddled fresh ginger steeped in simple syrup
ginger beer: Club soda + a few drops of ginger juice or ginger syrup
ginger ale: Club soda + a small amount of ginger syrup
tonic water: Club soda (less bitter, loses the quinine note)
prosecco: Any dry sparkling wine, Cava, or club soda for a lighter version
champagne: Prosecco, Cava, or any dry sparkling wine
cava: Prosecco or any dry sparkling wine
egg white: 0.5 oz aquafaba (chickpea liquid) for the same foam
whole egg: One egg white for foam only; omit yolk if unavailable
coconut cream: Heavy cream + a drop of coconut extract
half and half: Equal parts whole milk and heavy cream
angostura bitters: Any aromatic bitters — Fee Brothers Aromatic, or Peychaud's
orange bitters: A tiny strip of orange peel muddled in, or Angostura as a fallback
mole bitters: A dash of chocolate bitters + a pinch of chili powder
chocolate bitters: Mole bitters or a small piece of dark chocolate muddled in
celery bitters: A tiny pinch of celery salt
lavender bitters: A drop of lavender extract + Angostura bitters
lime juice: Lemon juice (slightly less tart; adjust to taste)
lemon juice: Lime juice (slightly more tart; adjust to taste)
grapefruit juice: Equal parts orange juice and lemon juice as a rough stand-in
pineapple juice: Mango juice or a mix of apple juice + a squeeze of lime
cranberry juice: Pomegranate juice or tart cherry juice
pomegranate juice: Cranberry juice or tart cherry juice
cold brew coffee: Strong espresso cooled down, diluted slightly
mezcal: Tequila (less smoky) or smoky Scotch for a different take
anejo tequila: Reposado tequila aged in bourbon barrel, or reposado + a small pour of bourbon
scotch: Irish whiskey (lighter) or bourbon with a drop of liquid smoke
white rum: Blanco tequila or vodka in a pinch
overproof rum: Use 1.5x the amount of standard rum
gin: Vodka (loses botanical notes) or aquavit for a different herbal spin
vodka: Gin (adds botanical flavor) or white rum
whiskey: Bourbon or rye depending on the recipe direction
hendrick's neptunia gin: Regular Hendrick's Gin or any London Dry gin, plus a pinch of sea salt for the briny note
neptunia gin: Regular Hendrick's Gin or any London Dry gin, plus a pinch of sea salt for the briny note
barr hill gin: Any London Dry gin plus a small bar spoon of honey
barr hill tom cat aged gin: A barrel-aged gin like Ransom Old Tom, or light bourbon with a dash of juniper bitters
barr hill old tom gin: Ransom Old Tom Gin, or London Dry gin plus a bar spoon of simple syrup
barr hill tom cat reserve gin: Any barrel-aged gin, or light whiskey with a drop of juniper bitters
